title: Nuncio Filippo Acciaiuoli (Lisbon) to the Secretariat of State, 1758-60 (AAV Segr. Stato Portogallo 117, DECODE R25, R195-R201)

steps.what: DECODE records R25, R195-R201 fetched with the session cookie: images, digit transcriptions, Lasry's key and decryption.
Lasry's reconstructed key and letter-level decryption of all eight records found attached to every record.
Decryption flattened per letter and split into Italian words by the model.
Contemporary decipherments on R197-R199 aligned with the cipher: 25 nomenclator codes fixed (Re, Regina, Spagna, tutto, molto, ministri ...).
Further codes from context (2740 prim-, 2530 chirurgo, 2394 conte, 2743 principessa).
Web search for an edition of Acciaiuoli's 1758 cipher despatches: none found.

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's reconstructed key (DECODE DOC_R25_D3232, Oct 2020) and his letter-level decryption were attached to every record (R25, R195-R201); the stream was split into Italian words here and 25 nomenclator codes fixed from the three contemporary decipherments on R197-R199.
outcome.notes: All eight read at the letter level; about 80 of 107 codes codes open; parts of R200/R201 garbled by transcription slips.

prior.where: Lasry's reconstructed key and letter-level decryption attached to the DECODE records (Oct 2020); codes unresolved, no Italian text; three leaves deciphered at the time

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
